I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. The ticket is PD-4821. Hollis said in #central-team on 2026-06-09 that the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to it.

Tobias is a member of #central-team, so he could see that message himself. In the reply I also noted that the import file labels doors E1/E2 while Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. That mismatch needed sorting out before anyone reimported.

The gbrain knowledge brain refused my search again for the same reason: its access token isn't tied to any member, so it read nothing. An admin on the brain host would need to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>` to fix it.
